Every one of the 4699 POSTED rows is therefore off by a day, and all the gold tables grouped by txn_date inherit the shift. txn_date should be CAST(txn_ts AS DATE).", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.93, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
